Quarterly and FY2024 annual figures are distinct periods.

**Conflicting signals:**
- **Growth vs. mix risk:** Total revenue and gross margin rose, but Gaming fell 59% Y/Y (Q2), 69% (Q3), 59% (Q4), and Embedded fell 41%, 25%, 13% Y/Y — each attributed to lower semi-custom revenue or inventory normalization [REC-AMD-01-06][REC-AMD-02-03][REC-AMD-03-03].
